stem: How does the poet’s use of language in these lines contribute to a happy mood in the poem?
instruction: Read lines 19 through 21 of the poem “The Apollo 11 Moon Landing.”

options.label: A
options.text: By highlighting the power the moon has to capture the speaker’s attention

options.label: B
options.text: By pointing out that the moon rises according to a predictable pattern

options.label: C
options.text: By emphasizing pleasant associations with the times when the moon appears

options.label: D
options.text: By detailing how the moon is continually studying humans

visual_elements:
Of our winter nights
Our soft spring twilights
Our summer dreams.
